page.overview:
Who is Alien Kid?

Alien Kid, known as Alien Kids in the Japanese version, is a character version of the card "Alien Kid".

It appears in the video game Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's World Championship 2011: Over the Nexus.

This character and Reptilianne Viper can be unlocked as Tag Duel opponents by having 100 total tag duels. Their Tag Team name is Alien Meets Snake.
